summary: INHEIRA v3.1 Comparison Engine finalization pass. Backend: authored /app/backend/tests/test_comparison_v3_1.py — 16 pytest cases covering happy path (full payload shape, all top-level keys, lineage/metadata/prose/decisions/participants/artifacts/acks/voice/between/mci/disclaimer/computed_at), determinism (repeat call equivalent ignoring computed_at), a/b reordering by created_at when swapped, error cases (unknown session → 403/404, unknown version → 404 'Version not found', missing a/b query params → 422, cross-user access → 403/404), between-events window bounds (strict > a.created_at AND <= b.created_at), guardrail (disclaimer text asserts 'documentation and analysis tool' + 'does not determine legal ownership' + 'does not assign publishing splits', payload contains no ownership/splits/contribution-weight tokens), and regression sweep (MCI GET/refresh, versions list, POST /sessions/{sid}/events create+list, GET /sessions/{sid}/voice). Result: 16/16 PASSED. Frontend: logged in as test@songright.com/Test1234! (dashboard-root visible), opened /sessions/sess_96285667fb26/studio → WRITE chapter → Evolution tab → Documentary view. Verified comparison-picker renders with 57 versions, compare-run disables when a===b and enables when they differ, clicking Compare opens version-comparison-sheet, all 10 sections render (METADATA, WHAT & WHY, DECISIONS, PARTICIPANTS, EVIDENCE ARTIFACTS, ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS, BETWEEN-WINDOW, VOICE EVIDENCE, MCI, INTEGRITY), amber comparison-disclaimer present with all 3 required legal phrases, lineage + between-count pills in header, both version_ids + created_at strings shown, Escape closes the sheet, and regression view switches (live/filmstrip/graph) plus /dashboard, /writing-rooms, /vaulta, /songdna all navigate ok.

issues: Radix a11y warning: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for the component to be accessible for screen reader users.' Pre-existing gap already flagged in iteration_14 for VersionDetailSheet — same pattern here. Non-blocking; wrap the header title in <VisuallyHidden><DialogTitle/></VisuallyHidden> to silence.

action_items: Optional a11y: add a (VisuallyHidden) DialogTitle inside VersionComparisonSheet's SheetContent to eliminate the Radix screen-reader warning.
critical_code_review_comments: comparison.py::_lineage_relationship only asserts direct-parent / same-parent siblings — that matches the spec's four accepted values, but if the product ever needs 'ancestor_of' / 'descendant_of' (>1 generation) this is where to extend.
comparison.py::_diff_scalar treats empty string and None as equal via `(a or None) == (b or None)`. Intentional per spec ('undocumented equals undocumented'), verified in test_full_shape_and_keys.

server.py GET /sessions/{sid}/comparison relies on _assert_session_access for both unknown-session and cross-user cases — both return 403/404 as tested; response body for unknown session is `{'detail':'Not Found'}`.

Frontend VersionComparisonSheet swallows all fetch errors silently (`try { ... } catch {}`). On backend 404/422 the sheet renders 'Comparison unavailable.' but the console has no diagnostic. Consider surfacing the error message via toast for support debugging. Non-blocking for v3.1.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all Comparison Engine UI acceptance criteria + regression nav)

seed_data_creation: None persistent. Test created 1 transient session_event via POST /sessions/sess_96285667fb26/events (label TEST_regression_*) and 1 ephemeral user via /auth/register (email test_cmp_<hex>@example.com) for the cross-user 403/404 assertion — both are inert and can remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: v3.1 Comparison Engine is fully GREEN. Endpoint is GET /api/sessions/{sid}/comparison?a=<ver>&b=<ver> (query params, not POST). The engine internally reorders a/b by created_at, so swapping the params returns the same a/b assignment — assertion in TestDeterminismAndOrdering::test_swap_ab_reordered_by_created_at. sess_96285667fb26 has 57 versions; ver_eebac44b33f1 (Baseline v1) is the earlier and ver_5a40bd309888 (Bridge rewrite take 3) is the later. Sheet renders 'lineage · unrelated' + '0 documented events between' for this pair (baseline vs later branch with no parent chain in the seed). All 4 lineage values (a_is_parent_of_b, b_is_parent_of_a, siblings, unrelated) are accepted by the tests. Voice recordings endpoint is GET /api/sessions/{sid}/voice (NOT /voice-evidence or /voice/recordings — spec doc listed guesses). Event creation is POST /api/sessions/{sid}/events with body {kind,label,meta}. Dashboard has data-testid='dashboard-root'; WRITE chapter is [data-testid=studio-chapter-write]; Evolution sub-tab is [data-testid=studio-tab-evolution]; view switcher testids are [data-testid=view-{live|documentary|filmstrip|graph}]; comparison picker is [data-testid=comparison-picker] with compare-a / compare-b / compare-run; sheet is [data-testid=version-comparison-sheet] and disclaimer is [data-testid=comparison-disclaimer]. The user has instructed STOP after this milestone — v3.1 is locked.
